entries.title: New menu and new modules
lines: New module menu: Mods, Profiles and Waypoints as cards with search, categories and favourites.
Glass look for every QuickClient menu.
Round, smaller minimap; no more minimap lag.
Performance: dynamic render distance, background FPS limit, particle saver, presets, lag spikes, FPS graph.
New modules: compass strip, pickup feed, supply watch, tool guard, night timer, clock, potion effects, crosshair and more.
Waypoints: beams from bedrock to the sky, types, favourites, temporary waypoints, quick key B.
Keybind manager, HUD presets, notifications and an 11-step tutorial.
Old info lines (dimension, time, day, facing, biome) and the Notes page were removed.

entries.title: World map and beams
lines: World map on M with saved exploration per world.
Waypoint light beams in the world.
New armor HUD, mouse-wheel zoom and the performance panel.

entries.title: First release
lines: HUD widgets, keystrokes, minimap, notes and waypoints.
